title: Which one fails?
examObjective: Converting between output types and data types using DataWeave
prompt: Three of these run. **One fails.** Which one?

explanation.approach: Only the text "true" and "false" coerce to Boolean. Anything else, however obviously affirmative, is an error. Going the other way, from Boolean to String, always works.

snippets.label: The two that coerce
snippets.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
["true" as Boolean, "false" as Boolean, true as String]
snippets.note: For "yes"/"no" data, compare the String instead of coercing it.
